chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from Al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
A man came to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and said: 'Pray to Allah for me that He admit me into Paradise.' So he said: 'Help me by abundant sajdah.'

key_terms.أَعِنِّي: Assist me, meaning support my intercession or request through your deeds
key_terms.السُّجُودِ: Prostration; here, frequent prostration in salat
key_terms.الْجَنَّةَ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward

ai.seo_question: How does abundant sajdah help a person enter Paradise?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that abundant sajdah and devotion in salat are among the means to attain Paradise. It also shows that seeking nearness to Allah is tied to personal worship and sincere effort.
